items.Sentence: The two WRPs independently utilize the same process trains which include influent pumping, primary sedimentation...
...process trains which include influent pumping, primary sedimentation, activated sludge biological treatment...
...activated sludge biological treatment with nitrification/denitrification, secondary sedimentation...
...activated sludge biological treatment with nitrification/denitrification, secondary sedimentation, coagulation...
...coagulation, inert media filtration, chlorination for disinfection...

Sodium hypochlorite is used as a disinfectant at the Facility. The disinfecting agent is added to the treated effluent prior to the filters to destroy bacteria, pathogens and viruses, and to minimize algal growth in the filters. Additional disinfectant may be dosed prior to the serpentine chlorine contact chamber.
Prior to discharge, sodium bisulfite is added to the treated effluent to remove residual chlorine. The Facility also has a backup sodium bisulfite dechlorination system.
